_readme: Evidence for published prices. A price is shown only when its id has a qualifying evidence pair: (a) a matching RepairPal estimate plus one independent corroborating source from a different data provider, or (b) a logged RepairPal coverage gap plus two independent sources from different providers. Every source needs url, provider, accessed (YYYY-MM-DD), vehicle (year make model engine), location (ZIP/state or 'national'), figure_lo, figure_hi and scope (parts grade, labor, exclusions). Sites that share a data provider count as one provider. See tools/evidence.js.
